title: Acquirer: IBM Australia Ltd; Target: Rational Software Corporation Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: On 11 February 2003, the Commission received a submission from International Business Machines Corporation advising of its proposed acquisition of Rational Software Corporation.
body_sections.Market definition: The national market for software application design and construction tools.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 11 March 2003, the Commission decided not to intervene in the proposed acquisition.  This decision was taken on the basis of the following reasons: - the acquisition is largely complementary with minimal overlap in product offerings; - there are large volumes of imported products; - there are many large global players; - the market is characterised by emerging products and technologies; and - countervailing power is held by resellers and retailers.
